subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: What sensitive run/session evidence, if any, should OpenClaw expose to pre-send plugin hooks for deterministic outbound verification?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but choosing whether the API belongs in `message_sending`, `reply_payload_sending`, or a broader trace/policy surface requires a public Plugin SDK and privacy/security boundary decision.

options.title: Design Bounded Hook Evidence
options.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields and permission semantics, then implement the additive hook contract with tests and docs.

options.title: Make reply_payload_sending Canonical
options.body: Treat `reply_payload_sending` as the supported pre-delivery API and narrow remaining work to the exact missing run/evidence fields there.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Policy Work
options.body: Make a broader outbound policy or trace-context issue canonical while preserving this issue's deterministic verification examples as acceptance criteria.

recommendation.title: Design Bounded Hook Evidence
recommendation.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields and permission semantics, then implement the additive hook contract with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and reviewed the closest prior outbound hook changes and already called out this exact remaining contract gap.
